faqs.q: I have a GD03-019 Gundam AGE-2 Normal with the effect "Enemy Units choose this rested Unit as their attack target if possible when attacking" in play when I choose 1 of my other rested Units and activate this effect. At this time, which Unit does my opponent have to give priority to for their attack?
faqs.a: When your opponent's Unit attacks, they have to give priority to the Unit chosen with this effect.

faqs.q: If multiple Units are chosen with this effect, which Unit does my opponent have to give priority to for their attack?
faqs.a: They choose 1 Unit from among those chosen with this effect and attack it.

faqs.q: I play this card during the action step after an enemy Unit has attacked. At this time, does the currently attacking Unit's attack target change to this effect's chosen Unit?
If this effect's chosen Unit has left the field, can enemy Units attack?
faqs.a: Yes, they can. Since this effect's chosen Unit is not present, they can choose and attack any rested enemy Unit or the player.

faqs.q: If this effect's chosen Unit is active, can enemy Units attack?
faqs.a: Yes, they can. According to the rules, this effect's chosen Unit cannot be chosen, so they can choose and attack any other rested enemy Unit or the player.

faqs.q: If this effect's chosen Unit is active, does an enemy Unit with the effect "this Unit may choose an active enemy Unit as its attack target" have to choose that chosen Unit when it attacks?
